violation_type.title: Background Check Validation - Once a year listed family homes, licensed, and registered child care homes must validate list of subjects (26 TAC §745.651(2)(B))
violation_type.short_title: Background Check Validation - Once a year listed family homes, licensed, and registered child care homes must validate list of subjects
violation_type.typical_finding: During the follow-up inspection the owner validation check was not done.

finding_variants.text: During the follow-up inspection the owner validation check was not done.
The background check list has not been validated since 05/20/2024.
The annual background validation was due 04/03/2025. This verification had not been completed by the director.
This had not been done since March 16, 2021.
The Licensed childcare home has been operating for 12 months. The primary caregiver has not validated the background check list. There is no current date for the background/employment validation.
The operation did not validate the list of persons associated with the operation annually. Last validation was completed on 5/30/23.
